dataset: MDIC Tarifas Vigentes — Anexos I a X da Resolução Gecex 272/2021
notes: The complete current MDIC workbook and RFB TIPI are represented in the versioned semantic snapshot consumed by the canonical federal resolver.
Missing NCMs are never interpreted as zero tax.
EX, quota, validity and competing treatments are resolved fail-closed and require evidence whenever they can change the applicable rate.
Tariff preference agreements and explicit professional overrides remain separate legal layers and are never inferred from row order.
